changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[ResponsibilityOwnershipField] as select ResponsibilityTypeName, AssetID, AssetTypeID, ResourceName, iif(SecurityType = 1, GroupName, ResourceName) as SecurityAssetName, ApplyToType, IsVisible, iif(SecurityType = 1, GroupUid, ResourceUid) as SecurityAssetUid from ResponsibilitySummary where IsVisible = 1
